summary: Beltrami County tower listed as gone by the Forest Fire Lookout Association; no second source found for its history.

facts.status_note: Listed as gone; no source describes what remains at the site.

evidence.supports: FFLA lists O'Brien as a gone tower in Beltrami County at 47.75923, -94.69871

sources.title: Minnesota Lookouts - Forest Fire Lookout Association

notes_for_editor: Single source: the FFLA Minnesota list gives name, county, coordinates and gone status only. Two web searches (O'Brien fire tower Beltrami County; O'Brien fire tower history) found nothing naming a lookout of this name. The matches were O'Brien Township in Beltrami County and William O'Brien State Park in Washington County, which are not lookouts, and the Pinewood tower moved to the Bemidji fairgrounds, which is a different tower. The story is deliberately short; hold it or publish as a stub until a second source turns up. Leads: the FFLA catalog of historical and extant Minnesota fire towers, Beltrami County Historical Society, Minnesota DNR records.
